If were to write a review for Warframe without taking time to think about what I'm gonna write, it would be pretty biased honestly. I would love to say that Warframe is one of the best games of all time, and that the gameplay is so entertaining and I could play for hours on end, but that's not the case. Yes, Warframe is a very, very good game with great characters, fun gameplay that makes you feel like you really are a  badass space ninja, tons of customization that makes you feel unique amongst millions of other players, and interesting lore that revolves around the world and the characters, and the experience only gets better when you have friends to play with; although, like any other video game, especially games that fall inot the MMO genre or have MMO elements in them, it has it's down side like endless farming, leveling, etc. With that in mind though, I still think that Warframe is an amazing game, even with it's flaws here and there, and the somewhat repetitive gameplay. I would still definitelly recommend it to anyone that was thinking of playing it.

Pros:
1. Nice art/graphics/designs/world building.
2. Excellent loot.
3. Pretty good farming experience for seasoned grinders.
4. Good fluid combat.

Cons
1. Bad trading system
2. Repetitive and extremely boring missions.
3. Limited end game content.
4. ftp model is not really ftp (2 inv slots/limited warframes etc) unless you spend an ubsurd ammount of time with only the starter warframes untill you get the plat.
5. Really sab par party play.

Overall a good game but not good enough to completely hook an old gamer like me. I moved to other games but I would recommend this one.

11/2017 Edit: So I think a revisit to this review is necessary. All of the above still hold but the game is indeed a lot better after the POE expansion. I was back for 2 months straight and only now I'm starting to get bored again.
Overall a much better experience.
Gets a solid 7/10 from me

An awesome game for any gamer! It's got a little something for everyone, with missions that can last anywhere from 2 minutes to hours and hours apon end(if you can survive that long). A diverse ability development system and amazing story, graphics that can blow your mind(especially for a free to play), and nothing needs money to be spent on ith either! You can of course, and it does make life easier to a degree, but not at all required, and it's not ridiculously arduous to grind for the plat otherwise like it is in some games.
Overall a great find that I certainly will keep for a long long time to come.
